newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising on positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising on positive sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may rise on Sunday amid expectations that the DSE council would soon be reorganised to boost investor confidence, brokers said.
"There is news that the governing body (council) of the DSE may be reorganised within a couple of days. This will contribute to confidence building in the market," said broker Khurshid Alam.
Brokers said council members of the exchange might hold a meeting on Sunday to discuss the reorganisation issue following the resignation of five council members.
Brokers said many of the council members had been implicated in a recent share price manipulations which caused upheavals in the market.
The DSE benchmark index closed 39.46 points or 3.71 percent up at 1,101.68 on a turnover of 51.2 million taka on Saturday.
